items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Is it – it’s not If I Ever Lose this Heaven? That’s Al Jarreau’s first record.

ctx.x: I see his copying – I mean, I see his hand on things you have him do, where you – like the thing with – what is it? – Al Jarreau? What is that wonderful piece? I can’t remember what it was, but . . .
Is it – it’s not If I Ever Lose this Heaven? That’s Al Jarreau’s first record.
